blocks.text: Robinsons Hotels and Resorts (RHR), the hospitality arm of Robinsons Land Corporation, is bringing together its diverse portfolio of hotel brands under one roof for the first Robinsons Hotels and Resorts Travel Fair, happening from October 16 to 18, 2026 at the Main Atrium of Robinsons Galleria. As the Philippines’ largest and most diversified hospitality group, RHR operates 10 brands and 30 properties across 20 cities and municipalities nationwide, offering a wide range of hospitality experiences, from ultra-luxury and upscale hotels to full-service and essential-value accommodations. Guided by the theme “Reasons to Travel,” the three-day event gives travelers the opportunity to […]...
